unscoped_processing_benchmark.scope: Synthetic HTTP only, actual native JS wrappers; local processing and request counts, no network/device speed guarantee

final_installed_entry_checks.scope: Dedicated plugin with literal native JS wrappers and Python HTTP; no physical device test

additional_observations.effect: Playlist rejected; one remaining VF link. Later final-bundle checks return both editions. No validation weakened.

limitations: The exact minute-long phone failure was not reproduced; the app timeout and held-host coupling are a structural diagnosis, not an identified failing device URL.
Independent entries isolate individual host delays; shared metadata, source-site outages or app-side mapping can still affect every entry.
Each entry repeats discovery and owns its own budget/settings. The fallback entry pools unassigned hosts.
Native HTTP cancellation and physical Android decoding/subtitle rendering remain unverified or app-owned.
Bleach retains media/caption probe failures; Mobile S2E22 records a recovered extraction HTTP failure.
